paite: Paul leh Timothi, Khrist Jesu sikhate'n, Philippi a om misiangthou tengteng leh heutute leh upate kiang ah:
heading: Chibai Bukna
english: Paul and Timothy, servants of Jesus Christ, to all the saints in Christ Jesus who are at Philippi, with the overseers and servants:

paite: Hehpihna leh khamuanna i Pa Pathian leh Toupa Jesu Khrist a kipan na tung uah om hen.
english: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

paite: Noute ka hon theihgigena ah ka Pathian kiang ah kipahthu ka gen hi,
heading: Paul Kipahthu Genna
english: I thank my God whenever I remember you,

paite: na vek ua ding a kipaktak a thum a ka hon ngetsakna teng ah;
english: always in every request of mine on behalf of you all, making my requests with joy,

paite: ani masapen a pan tuni tanpha a tanchinhoih a na kithuahkhawmna ziak ua kipak in.
english: for your partnership in furtherance of the Good News from the first day until now;

paite: Hiai thil mahmah gingta ing; amah nou a nasep hoih panpa'n Jesu ni tanpha in azoukim vek ding hi.
english: being confident of this very thing, that he who began a good work in you will complete it until the day of Jesus Christ.

paite: Na vek ua tungtang thu a, ke'n hichibang lungsim ka neih adik ahi, ka lungtang a ka hon neih ziak in; ka kolbutna leh tanchinhoih gupna leh hihkipna thu a hehpihna ka tanpihte na hi vek uhi.
english: It is even right for me to think this way on behalf of all of you, because I have you in my heart, because both in my bonds and in the defense and confirmation of the Good News, you all are partakers with me of grace.

paite: Khrist Jesu hehpihna nou ngiingei ah nou ka hon ngai mahmah chih Pathian in ahon theihpih hi.
english: For God is my witness, how I long after all of you in the tender mercies of Christ Jesus.

paite: Noute theihna leh theihkakna toh kithuah itna a na khan semsemna ding un ka thum hi.
english: This I pray, that your love may abound yet more and more in knowledge and all discernment,

paite: Huchi a thil hoihpen na deih ua, Khrist ni a siangthou leh dembei a na omtheihna ding uh leh,
english: so that you may approve the things that are excellent, that you may be sincere and without offense to the day of Christ,

paite: Pathian thupina leh pahtawina ding a, Jesu Khrist ziak a hong om dikna gahte na dimtheihna ding un.
english: being filled with the fruits of righteousness which are through Jesus Christ, to the glory and praise of God.

paite: Unaute aw, tu in ka tung a thil hong tungte, tanchinhoih akhanna dia hong tung ahi uh chih na theih uh ka deih;
heading: Paul Suangkul Tanna Ziakte
english: Now I desire to have you know, brothers, that the things which happened to me have turned out rather to the progress of the Good News,

paite: huchi in inpi vengpawl tengteng leh adang tengteng kiang ah Khrist ziak a kolbun ka hi chih achiangta hi.
english: so that it became evident to the whole palace guard, and to all the rest, that my bonds are in Christ,

paite: Ka kolbuhna a kipan a Toupa muanna nei in unaute lak a tampite lau lou a Pathian thu gen ding in nakpitak in ahong hangsan deuhdeuhta uhi.
english: and that most of the brothers in the Lord, being confident through my bonds, are more abundantly bold to speak the word of God without fear.

paite: Khenkhatte'n hazatna ziak leh thangpaihna ziak in Khrist atangkoupih ua; khenkhatte'n hoih asak ziak un agen uh.
english: Some indeed preach Christ even out of envy and strife, and some also out of good will.

paite: Pawl khatte'n itna ziak in, tanchinhoih dikdan gen dia om ka hihdan thei in agen uhi.
english: The former insincerely preach Christ from selfish ambition, thinking that they add affliction to my chains;

paite: Himahleh pawl dang in kikhenna ding in Khrist atangkoupih ua, ataktak hilou in ka kolbuhna a ka thuakna behlap tum in.
english: but the latter out of love, knowing that I am appointed for the defense of the Good News.

paite: Bang apoi a? Kong bangkim a Khrist akigenkhiak photleh akhem hi in atak hitaleh, huai ah ka kipak hi. Ahi, ka kipak zel lai ding hi.
english: What does it matter? Only that in every way, whether in pretense or in truth, Christ is proclaimed. I rejoice in this, yes, and will rejoice.

paite: Na thumnate uh leh Jesu Khrist Kha panpihna ziak in hiai ka suahtakna hong suak ding chih ka thei hi.
heading: Khrist A Hinna Leh Sihna
english: For I know that this will turn out to my salvation through your prayers and the supply of the Spirit of Jesus Christ,

paite: Ka gintak taktakna leh ka lametna bang in bangmah ah hihzum in ka om kei hial dia, himahleh ahi gige sa mah bang in tu in leng ka hinna hiam ka sihna hiam in ka pumpi ah hangsanna kim toh Khrist hihlet in a-om ngeingei ding hi.
english: according to my earnest expectation and hope, that I will in no way be disappointed, but with all boldness, as always, now also Christ will be magnified in my body, whether by life or by death.

paite: Kei a ding in zaw hin Khrist ahi a, huan sih leng punna ahi.
english: For to me to live is Christ, and to die is gain.

paite: Himahleh sa a hin ka tan ding hitaleh kei a ding in sepgim gah tampi suahna ding ahi. Hinapi in ka tel ding pen ka thei kei.
english: But if I live on in the flesh, this will bring fruit from my work; yet I don’t know what I will choose.

paite: Nih kalteh in hamhaihtak in ka om hi. Paimang a Khrist kiang a om utna ka nei a; huai lah nakpitak in ahoihzaw ngal a.
english: But I am hard pressed between the two, having the desire to depart and be with Christ, which is far better.

paite: Himahleh noute ziak in sa a om phot akiphamohzaw hi.
english: Yet to remain in the flesh is more needful for your sake.

paite: Huchi in hiai ginna ka neih ziak in, ka om phot ding chih ka thei; ginna a na khanletna ding uh leh na kipahna ding un, na vek ua lak ah ka om phot ding hi;
english: Having this confidence, I know that I will remain, yes, and remain with you all for your progress and joy in the faith,

paite: huchi a na kiang ua ka hong pai nawn ding ziak a Khrist Jesu na suanna ding uh tam semsem kei a na neihna ding un.
english: that your boasting may abound in Christ Jesus in me through my presence with you again.

paite: Na omdan uh Khrist tanchinhoih toh kituaksak photphot un; hong hoh a, nou hong muh hiam, ahihkeileh ka om louh a leng kha khat a na dinkipdan uh leh lungsim khat nei a tanchinhoih thugin a na pandan uh, na tanchin uh ka zaktheihna ding in.
english: Only let your way of life be worthy of the Good News of Christ, that whether I come and see you or am absent, I may hear of your state, that you stand firm in one spirit, with one soul striving for the faith of the Good News;

paite: Huan bangmah ah na melmate uh hihlau in om kei un. Huai amau a ding in manna ding kichetna teltak ahi a, himahleh nou a ding in hotdamna ding kichetna ahi, huai Pathian a kipan ahi.
english: and in nothing frightened by the adversaries, which is for them a proof of destruction, but to you of salvation, and that from God.

paite: Hiai tuh noute a ding in phal ahita; Khrist gingtate kia hilou in, ama ziak in na thuak sam ding uh.
english: Because it has been granted to you on behalf of Christ, not only to believe in him, but also to suffer on his behalf,

paite: Keimah a na muh uleh na zak uh huai kidouna mah na dou ding uh ahi.
english: having the same conflict which you saw in me and now hear is in me.
